description: Naturally occurring copper complex of the tripeptide glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine, known for its use in skincare products. It is valued for its potential benefits in promoting skin health and wound healing, often included in formulations to enhance skin regeneration and reduce signs of aging. The primary users of GHK-Cu are individuals seeking anti-aging skincare solutions and improved skin health.
